title: Workflow Ralph defaults
description: Optional repo-local defaults for workflow-ralph and queue spawn tuning. Secrets (Postgres URLs, auth tokens) must not appear in this file. Precedence: built-ins < this file < environment variables < CLI / enqueue payload.

backend.description: Execution backend for the entire plan run (same as WORKFLOW_RALPH_BACKEND / --backend).

prompt.description: Command-style prompt profile (mutually exclusive with promptFile).

promptFile.description: UTF-8 prompt file path, cwd-relative or absolute (mutually exclusive with prompt).

taskIterations.description: Opt-in max iterations for task-centric mode (WORKFLOW_RALPH_TASK_ITERATIONS / --task-iterations). Unset keeps the single-task rule (effective 1).

model.description: Model preset when the backend supports it (WORKFLOW_RALPH_MODEL / --model).

worktreeBase.description: Cursor-only base branch for new agent worktree (WORKFLOW_RALPH_WORKTREE_BASE).

debug.description: Debug shim level when CLI --debug/--verbose are omitted.

transport.description: Ralph OpenThrottle I/O transport (WORKFLOW_RALPH_TRANSPORT). Env alias postgres maps to postgres-direct.

spawn.description: Nested workflow-ralph spawn tuning (worker → child). Paths should be absolute.

otRoot.description: OpenThrottle monorepo root for workflow-ralph bin resolution (WORKFLOW_RALPH_OT_ROOT).

lifecycleHooksChildJobs.description: When false, disables lifecycle hook child jobs (OPENTHROTTLE_LIFECYCLE_HOOKS_CHILD_JOBS=false). Default true when omitted.
